text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon visiting the gym, many Umamusume were 
hard at work doing strength training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems there are quite a few Umamusume 
aiming for the Tiara route today, like 
Lucky Lilac. Just as I'm thinking that――

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Nnnnghhhhh...!!!! Haaah――!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both of them were lifting the dumbbells 
with all their might, wearing looks of 
sheer desperation――!
choice_data_list: (She's working so hard...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile――
choice_data_list: （すごく頑張ってる……！！）

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ――Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While the powerhouse Kawakami Princess and 
upperclassman Verxina struggled with their 
strength training, Lucky Lilac tackled it 
calmly.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello, Trainer. Thanks for all your 
hard work.
choice_data_list:
Good work. Amazing how calm and composed 
you stayed!

Good work. Amazing how calm and composed 
you stayed!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Thank you, I'm truly honored by your 
praise.
choice_data_list: お疲れ様。冷静にやっていてすごいな！
お疲れ様。冷静にやっていてすごいね！
choice_data_list_en: Good work. It's amazing how calm you were!
Good work. It's amazing how calm you were!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Right... Shall we finish things off with 
this next?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a confident smirk, she pulled out the 
chest expander――!
choice_data_list:
Try doing it with the image of slowly 
spreading it out!
Looks like it'll build up back muscles...!

Looks like a great workout for the back 
muscles...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a confident smirk, she pulled out the 
chest expander――!
choice_data_list: ゆっくり広げるイメージでやるといいよ！
背筋が鍛えられそうだな……！
背筋が鍛えられそうだね……！
choice_data_list_en: Try visualizing spreading it out slowly!
That looks like it'll really train your back muscles...!
That looks like it'll really train your back muscles...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well, some advice. Let's put that to good 
use, then—
choice_data_list: ゆっくり広げるイメージでやるといいよ！
背筋が鍛えられそうだな……！
背筋が鍛えられそうだね……！
choice_data_list_en: Try visualizing spreading it out slowly!
That looks like it'll really train your back muscles...!
That looks like it'll really train your back muscles...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ――Hah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With an entirely cool and composed look, 
she stretched open the chest expander!
choice_data_list: Ooh, looking good!
Wow, looks great!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the praise. Right then, let's 
move on to the next training session♪
choice_data_list: おぉ、いい感じだな！
わぁ、いい感じだね！

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, she breezed through 
several more training routines without 
breaking a sweat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Strengthening back muscles leads to a 
stable form. She must be trying that out.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
My, just as expected of you, Trainer. You 
are completely right. —Now then, let us 
begin.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRRAAAAASH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps the fatigue finally caught up to 
her, as the chest expander slipped right 
from her grasp...!
choice_data_list: A-Are you all right!?
A-Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Aye. I ain't hurt none, so I'm grand. 
Sorry for givin' ya a fright.
choice_data_list: だ、大丈夫か！？
だ、大丈夫！？

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I taught her stretches in detail. She 
listened eagerly to everything I had to 
say.
choice_data_list: 念のため、ケア用のストレッチを教えるよ
choice_data_list_en: Just in case, I'll show you some recovery stretches.
